## Summary

Roni Seikh builds full-stack web applications and AI/ML-integrated tools. Core stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, Flask, Python, MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL. Applied AI/ML work includes NLP, machine learning models (scikit-learn), and data analytics/visualization (Pandas, NumPy, Power BI).
